addressable_scale.description: Reachable units in the flight, recomputed against the buyer's selection. Not segment size

agreement_ref.description: OPTIONAL. Reference to a master or annual agreement the line item is priced under: `{ agreement_id, parties[], type: upfront | annual | master_services | other, valid_from, valid_until }`, where `parties[]` names the seller by its `seller_id` and the buyer by the id it holds in `eligible_bidders[]` (§ 5.8). An informative pointer; the agreement itself is outside this specification. A buyer-held agreement id travels as an `external_references[]` entry with `role: agreement`

assets.description: Buyer-delivered. `{ asset_id, format_ref, url_or_tag, submitted_at, approval_status }`

audiences.description: `available[]` of `{ id, name, taxonomy_ref, provenance, addressable_scale }`, `included[]`, `pricing` as `delta_cpm` per option, `max_select`

availability.description: `{ unit, basis, as_of, granularity, type: forecast | reservable, quantity }`. Recomputed against the buyer's selection

billing.description: `{ supplier_id, billing_supplier_id, payment_terms, invoicing_party }`. Who delivers is not always who invoices

buyer_requirements.description: `{ seat_required, dsp_allowed[] }` are seller-set; `{ dsp_seat_id, dsp_id, seat_owner_entity }` are supplied

buyer_supplied.description: `{ segments_allowed, suppression_allowed, match_rate_expected, segments[], suppression_list }`. `match_rate_expected` is the seller's stated expectation; `segments[]` and `suppression_list` are buyer-populated

cancellation_policy.description: `available[]` of cancellation rights with `pricing` per option

channel.description: `display` | `video` | `audio` | `ctv` | `dooh` | `native`, each defined in 5.1.1. The discriminator for how the rest of the line item is read

commitment_bounds.description: The envelope inside which a buyer may commit: `{ min_impressions, max_impressions, min_budget, max_budget }`

committed_metrics.description: `{ metric, value, basis }` tuples — `viewable_rate` for display, `completion_rate` for video/audio/CTV, an audience-modelled metric for DOOH. Seller declares a ceiling; a buyer MAY request above it

correlation_id.description: One identity for this line item's commitment, carried across every system it touches

creative_delivery.description: `{ method: buyer_hosted | seller_hosted | api | platform_managed, protocol, secure_required, endpoint }`

creative_policy.description: Content and category restrictions on creative

daypart.description: `allowed[]` of `{ days[], start, end }`: `days[]` from `monday` | `tuesday` | `wednesday` | `thursday` | `friday` | `saturday` | `sunday`, HH:MM civil time, `end` exclusive, up to `24:00`

deal_id_issuance.description: When and how the deal id is minted. Issued at commitment time

exclusions.description: The buyer's block lists: `{ domain[], app_bundle[], iab_content_category[], keyword[], list_ref }`. See below

exclusions_accepted.description: What the seller can enforce: `{ types[], max_entries, enforcement, verification[] }`. See below

external_references.description: `{ system, namespace, id, role }`. Replaces platform-specific key names. A buyer-owned reference such as a Prisma `io_id` is supplied. Documented `role` values: `io`, an IO id generated by an order management system and carried back on the line item; `agreement`, a buyer-held agreement id

formats.description: `available[]` of registry format ids namespaced by channel (`display/300x250`, `audio/host-read-30s`), `included[]`, `pricing`, `max_select`

frequency_cap.description: `{ max: { min, max }, period, basis: device | household | listener }`. Basis matters: CTV typically caps at household, audio at listener

geo.description: `available[]` of geo codes with `included[]`, `pricing` deltas and `max_select` (§ 3.1), for a line item priced by market. A `geo` that declares only `allowed[]` is `settable`. See below

materials_due.description: Deadline for creative to land. A buyer MAY request a later date

measurement_source.description: `available[]` of `{ vendor, attribution_window, qualifier }` with `pricing`. Lets a buyer transact in its own currency

min_spend.description: Minimum spend for this line item

placement.description: What every impression of this line item is: rewarded, interstitial, video placement subtype, skippability, playback, API frameworks and refresh. `plcmt` is REQUIRED for video ads. See 5.2.2

production.description: Custom units. `available[]` of build options with `pricing` and `lead_time`; `{ custom_unit, build_owner, lead_time, cost }`

properties.description: `available[]` of `{ id, name, domains, apps, supported_formats }`, `included[]`, `pricing`, `max_select`. Each property MUST carry `domains`, `apps` or both

reporting.description: `available[]` of `{ feed_type: log_level | aggregate | none, cadence, delivery_mechanism, metrics_provided[], latency }` with `pricing`

required_credentials.description: `{ type: iab_registry | dsp_seat | custom, scheme: api_key | oauth2_client_credentials | jwt_keypair | oidc_federated | none, issuer, id_required }`

requires.description: OPTIONAL. Conditions that must hold in the same commitment for this line item to be committable. See 5.6.3

specs.description: As defined by the referenced format registry entry. OpenProposal does not hardcode a shape per channel

status.description: `draft` | `published` | `under_review` | `agreed` | `withdrawn` | `sold_out` | `expired`. Independent of the proposal's status, so one line item may sell out while the rest of the shelf stays live

supported_order_systems.description: Declared up front so the agent knows it will reconcile

terms_acceptance_required.description: Whether legal terms must be accepted before assent

terms_ref.description: OPTIONAL; REQUIRED when `terms_acceptance_required` is `true`. `{ url, sha256, version }`: the legal terms or IO template the buyer accepts at assent. Hash-pinned, so assent (§ 4.1) binds to an exact document

third_party_tags.description: Accepted wrapper types and VAST versions

time_zone.description: IANA time zone name, or `viewer_local` (where the ad renders). The clock for `daypart` and `frequency_cap.period`. REQUIRED with either

transaction_mechanism.description: `available[]` from `DIRECT_IO` | `PROGRAMMATIC_GUARANTEED` | `PREFERRED_DEAL` | `PRIVATE_AUCTION` | `OPEN_AUCTION`. A seller MAY offer the same inventory through more than one

addressable_scale.description: Reachable units in the flight, recomputed against the buyer's selection. Not segment size

channel.description: `display` | `video` | `audio` | `ctv` | `dooh` | `native`, each defined in 5.1.1. The discriminator for how the rest of the line item is read

committed_metrics.description: `{ metric, value, basis }` tuples — `viewable_rate` for display, `completion_rate` for video/audio/CTV, an audience-modelled metric for DOOH. Seller declares a ceiling; a buyer MAY request above it

min_spend.description: Minimum spend for this line item

placement.description: The line item's `placement`, projected to `reward`, `instl`, `plcmt`, and `skip`.

pricing.description: The line item's `pricing[]`, each entry projected to `cost_method`, `gross_rate`, and `currency`.

transaction_mechanism.description: `available[]` from `DIRECT_IO` | `PROGRAMMATIC_GUARANTEED` | `PREFERRED_DEAL` | `PRIVATE_AUCTION` | `OPEN_AUCTION`. A seller MAY offer the same inventory through more than one

included.description: The options in the base rate, each named as `available[]` holds it: a string option by its value, and an object option by its `id`, the UUID the seller mints for it.

instl.description: `0` (no) | `1` (yes). The ad is interstitial or full screen

plcmt.description: One value from List: Plcmt Subtypes - Video: Instream (1), Accompanying Content (2), Interstitial (3), No Content/Standalone (4), Pause (5), Screensaver (6), Overlay (7), Squeezeback (8), In-scene (9)

reward.description: `0` (no) | `1` (yes). The user receives a reward for viewing the ad

skip.description: Video or audio. `0` (no) | `1` (yes). The placement lets the user skip the ad

gross_rate.description: The list rate the buyer pays

LineItemSummaryPropertiesOptionOrCatalog.description: A value given inline, or a reference to the seller's catalog entry that holds it, never both.

available.description: The line item's `properties.available[]`, each entry projected to `name`.

spec_version.description: The release of the specification the manifest follows, as the specification names its release, such as `3.0`.

assent.description: Buyer and seller assent records and timestamps for the binding version. Signature scheme is WS1

best_for.description: Advisory planning hints. Non-normative, and never the basis for a match

brief_ref.description: Reference to the buyer's brief. REQUIRED when `type` is `custom`

description.description: REQUIRED. Prose, not a name. Where the "why buy" case is made, including which channels a multi-channel proposal spans

linked_execution.description: `none` (default, subsettable) | `all` (every published line item must be committed together)

negotiation_history.description: Ordered, append-only. `{ version, actor: buyer | seller, action: proposed | countered | accepted | declined | withdrawn, fields_changed[], at }`. Entries MUST NOT be edited or removed

proposal_id.description: Unique identity for the proposal object

proposal_template_id.description: OPTIONAL. Links an issued proposal to the seller's template. Opaque to buyers; used for the seller's reporting

seller_name.description: Canonical legal seller entity name, from the registry

valid_from.description: ISO-8601 window the offer holds. This is the offer window, not the campaign flight

valid_until.description: ISO-8601 window the offer holds. This is the offer window, not the campaign flight

version.description: Monotonically increasing revision number. Each revision while status is `published` increments it

valid_from.description: ISO-8601 window the offer holds. This is the offer window, not the campaign flight

valid_until.description: ISO-8601 window the offer holds. This is the offer window, not the campaign flight

ProposalsEntry.description: One proposal the manifest publishes: its Summary Representation, its `version`, and the `full_url` of its full record. The specification doesn't name the key that holds its line items' summaries, so the entry accepts members it doesn't name.

proposal_id.description: Unique identity for the proposal object

seller_name.description: Canonical legal seller entity name, from the registry

valid_until.description: ISO-8601 window the offer holds. This is the offer window, not the campaign flight
